Class InvoiceCloneController

public with sharing class InvoiceCloneController

Apex controller for the invoiceClone Aura component. Clones an existing Invoice__c record along with its InvoiceLineItem__c children, automatically incrementing the invoice number. Supports both numeric and alphanumeric invoice number formats.

Methods

@AuraEnabled
public static String clone(String invoiceId)

Clones an Invoice__c and its InvoiceLineItem__c records. Retrieves the latest invoice number for the account, increments it (preserving prefix and zero-padding), sets today's date, and inserts the cloned records.

Parameters:
    invoiceId – The Id of the Invoice__c record to clone

Returns:
    String: The Id of the newly created invoice, or an empty string on failure
